requirements.text: normalize_safety_eval_run_id(value) strips whitespace from a string ID and raises ValueError for a non-string or an empty stripped ID.
unique_safety_eval_runs(records) keeps the first record for each ID, preserving first-occurrence order, returning an empty list for empty input and leaving inputs unchanged.
latest_safety_eval_run(records) returns the record with greatest timestamp, breaks ties by lexicographically smallest ID, and returns None for empty input.
mean_alignment_score(records) computes the arithmetic mean of the alignment_score field and returns zero for empty input.
